autedium_grindfulness.config.title: AuTedium - Grindfulness
autedium_grindfulness.config.tagline: less tedium, never less cost — full durability, full hunger, vanilla loot
autedium_grindfulness.config.weight.free: Fairness weight: none. Pure feedback/info — never counts against the verdict.
autedium_grindfulness.config.weight.desc: Fairness weight: +%s toward the verdict while enabled.
autedium_grindfulness.config.tunable.not: Tunables shift convenience, never cost — the fairness laws still apply.
autedium_grindfulness.group.mining.desc: Break more with fewer clicks. Every block still pays full durability and hunger.
autedium_grindfulness.group.sense.desc: Reveal what already exists. Nothing is ever spawned — pity and pings only show ore the world generated.
autedium_grindfulness.group.ritual.desc: Trade attention and hunger for compressed time. High fairness weight for a reason.
autedium_grindfulness.group.feedback.des: Toasts, stats, dopamine. Zero balance impact — these never touch the fairness verdict.
autedium_grindfulness.group.misc.desc: Modules that have not been sorted into a group yet.
autedium_grindfulness.option.vein_cap_or: Max connected ore blocks broken per sneak-break chain.
autedium_grindfulness.option.vein_cap_lo: Max connected logs felled per sneak-break chain.
autedium_grindfulness.option.flow_reset_: How long you can pause between breaks before the flow streak (and its Haste) fades.
autedium_grindfulness.option.pity_thresh: Blocks mined without a diamond before the pity reveal triggers.
autedium_grindfulness.option.pity_rechec: Extra blocks between re-scans once past the threshold with nothing found nearby.
autedium_grindfulness.option.pity_scan_r: How far the pity scan looks for an existing diamond vein. Reveal only, never spawns.
autedium_grindfulness.option.prospect_ra: How far a prospector ping reaches. Bigger radius, same law — the pickaxe pays durability.
autedium_grindfulness.option.vigil_multi: How fast nearby time compresses while kneeling. Hunger burns at the full multiplier.
autedium_grindfulness.option.vigil_radiu: How far the vigil's time compression reaches around you.
autedium_grindfulness.option.vigil_hunge: Minimum food level required to begin a vigil. Food is the fuel meter.
autedium_grindfulness.option.ledger_mile: Blocks between action-bar milestone flashes while grinding.
autedium_grindfulness.option.ledger_idle: Seconds of not grinding before the fuller session summary shows.
Sneak-break an ore or log to break the whole connected vein/tree. Pays full durability and hunger per block — same cost, less clicking.
Consecutive breaks of the same block family build Haste I→III. Stop or switch and it fades. Faster, not cheaper.
autedium_grindfulness.module.pity_ping.d: Long diamond dry streak while deep mining? The nearest existing vein glows briefly. Never spawns ore — reveal only.
Sneak + right-click with a pickaxe: nearby ores glow for 5s. 45s cooldown. The spiciest toggle here.
autedium_grindfulness.module.toasts.desc: Milestone popups and dry-streak progress. Pure feedback, zero balance impact.
autedium_grindfulness.module.grind_ledge: Session grind stats on the action bar: milestone flashes while you grind, a fuller summary when you stop. Pure info, zero balance impact.
autedium_grindfulness.module.vigil.desc: Press V to hold a vigil: pick how many game hours to wait (Skyrim-style) and kneel while time compresses nearby — crops, saplings, copper, leaves, furnaces, brewing stands, campfires. Daytime only, burns hunger at full multiplier, breaks on any movement or damage — you are a sitting duck.
autedium_grindfulness.vigil.not_day: vigil needs daylight (beds own the night)
autedium_grindfulness.vigil.too_hungry: too hungry to vigil — eat first
autedium_grindfulness.vigil.dusk: not enough daylight left to vigil (needs a full game hour)
autedium_grindfulness.vigil.screen.title: Hold Vigil
autedium_grindfulness.ledger.idle: ⛏ %s stone · %s logs · best streak %s · %s min grinding · %s
autedium_grindfulness.toast.pity.title: Dry streak
